scope: Bounded development baseline diagnosis: adapt only pointwise readouts, not SNN representation or allocation policy

exposure.zurich_city_01_a: Previously explored development sequence; paired before/after comparison, not pristine test
exposure.interlaken_00_c: New evaluation sequence selected by smallest public compressed size among c/d/e, before model inference; no confirmatory generalization claim

seed_scope: Three minibatch-order seeds from the same pretrained SNN and head initialization; not independent full-detector training seeds
loss: Upstream gt_creator multi_anchor + calculate_loss_new + Criterion; scale_loss=positive; no validation checkpoint selection
training_labels: Common car/pedestrian classes, clipped native boxes; upstream-style rounded 256 letterbox coordinates. Upstream ignores resized width or height <1; report count, never remove these from evaluation truth.
final_checkpoint_rule: Always epoch 12 for each seed; preserve epoch 1/4/12 checkpoints, evaluate only final
limitations: One training sequence and two evaluation journeys cannot establish broad generalization.
Head-only adaptation is a diagnostic; failure does not rule out full-model adaptation.
No deadline changes, no evaluation-based checkpoint selection, no H1/H2/H3 verdict.
Calibration FPPI does not imply identical achieved evaluation FPPI.
Feature caching is an offline experiment aid, not a runtime or efficiency claim.
